newsitem.title: USA: GM declines comment on sponsorship report.
newsitem.headline: GM declines comment on sponsorship report.

text.p: A General Motors Corp spokesman declined to comment Monday on a report that the automaker is planning a major Olympic sponsorship agreement, but said a news conference is planned for Wednesday.
GM spokesman Dean Rotondo said the news conference will be held at 1300 EDT at the NBC Studios in New York City. He would not say what will be discussed at the event.
The New York Times reported Monday that GM and General Electric Co's NBC Inc unit will announce a sponsorship agreement with the United States Olympic Committee.

The deal would start with the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney, Australia and would run into the next decade, and be worth several hundred million dollars, likely making it the biggest sports sponsorship ever, according to the paper.
A spokesman for the United States Olympic Committee in Colorado Springs, Colo. was not in the office and could not be immediately reached for comment.
